previous_assumption: Organizations store no contact details or address — only identity (id/type/name/code/status), and updateOrganizationRequestSchema is .strict() {name} only.
correction: Company details added as a separate one-to-one organization_profiles table (address, GST, PAN, bank details, website, logo_url) plus organization_contacts child table (name/designation/phone/email/sort_order) — migration 0040. Service getOrganizationProfile (membership.manage read gate) / updateOrganizationProfile (organization.manage write gate, full-replace incl. contacts list in one transaction).
